text:
ana: Morning — quick coordination: we need a release train slot for the v38 patch tomorrow. Prefer quiet window 10:00-10:30 UTC. Who can own deploy + smoke?

mike: I can take deploy, but I need smoke coverage from someone in infra.

sophia: I can do smoke checks — will be available 09:45-11:00 UTC. What services are in scope?

peter: v38 touches inference-routing, kv-cache, and the console metrics export. Expect schema migration for metrics (non-blocking).

jordan: Notes: metrics export migration is a simple column add; rollback just re-reads old schema. Confirming no DB migration requiring downtime?

peter: No downtime. Just config flag flip post-deploy.

mike: Plan: deploy job on release-train runner at 10:00, health-checks + smoke script ran at 10:05, manual sign-off by smoke owner by 10:15. Rollback window until 10:30. Sound good?

sophia: Sounds good. Can you post the smoke checklist here so I can review?

mike: Pasting quick smoke script (run on staging then prod):
```
# smoke.sh
curl -sSf https://api.redwood.example/health || exit 1
python tools/run_kv_smoke.py --reads 100 --writes 10 || exit 1
curl -sSf "https://console.redwood.example/metrics?test=1" || exit 1
```

sophia: OK, lgtm. Will run on prod from 10:05 and report result.

ana: (bot) deploy-bot created release train slot #v38-2026-03-19 10:00 UTC and assigned to mike.

ana: (bot) reminder scheduled: deploy-team reminder in #eng-releases 30m before 10:00 UTC.

mike: I'll kick the deploy at 10:00. If the smoke fails, i'll hit rollback procedure: `runner revert --to v37` and post here.

sophia: If I don't post a pass by 10:18, please assume failure and rollback. I'll aim to post pass/fail by 10:10.

jordan: One more ask — can someone confirm that the canary percent is set to 10% for traffic routing?

mike: Confirmed. Canary routing set to 10% and will auto-increase to 50% after 20m if metrics look stable.

sophia: Smoke PASSED 10:07 — all endpoints and KV checks green. :tada:

mike: Deploy completed 10:09, canary at 10%. Monitoring for errors.

ana: (bot) metrics-alert suppressed for deploy window by ops for 40m.

jordan: Watching logs. No new error spikes. :thumbsup:

sophia: Approving bump to 50% at 10:30 unless objections.

mike: No objections. I'll run the traffic increase at 10:30 and post update.

sophia: All good at 10:32 — canary stable, increasing to 100% now.

mike: Done, rollout complete 10:35. Closing slot. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
